[![](//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/8/81/France_national_football_1904.jpg/250px-France_national_football_1904.jpg)](/wiki/File:France_national_football_1904.jpg)

France national team that played its first international v [Belgium](/wiki/Belgium_national_football_team "Belgium national football team") in 1904.

The France national football team was created in 1904, around the time of [FIFA's foundation.](/wiki/History_of_FIFA "History of FIFA")[[18]](#cite_note-18) The team competed in [its first official international match](/wiki/%C3%89vence_Copp%C3%A9e_Trophy "Évence Coppée Trophy") on 1 May 1904 against [Belgium](/wiki/Belgium_national_football_team "Belgium national football team") in [Brussels](/wiki/Brussels "Brussels"), ending in a 3–3 draw.[[19]](#cite_note-19) The following year, on 12 February 1905, France contested their first-ever home match against [Switzerland](/wiki/Switzerland_national_football_team "Switzerland national football team"). The match was played at the [Parc des Princes](/wiki/Parc_des_Princes "Parc des Princes") in front of 500 supporters. France won the match 1–0 with the only goal coming from [Gaston Cyprès](/wiki/Gaston_Cypr%C3%A8s "Gaston Cyprès"). Due to disagreements between [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA "FIFA") and the *[Union des Sociétés Françaises de Sports Athlétiques](/wiki/Union_des_Soci%C3%A9t%C3%A9s_Fran%C3%A7aises_de_Sports_Athl%C3%A9tiques "Union des Sociétés Françaises de Sports Athlétiques")* (USFSA), the country's [sports union](/wiki/Sports_union "Sports union"), France struggled to establish an identity. On 9 May 1908, the French Interfederal Committee (CFI), a rival organization to the USFSA, ruled that FIFA would now be responsible for the club's appearances in forthcoming Olympic Games and not the USFSA. In 1919, the CFI transformed themselves into the [French Football Federation](/wiki/French_Football_Federation "French Football Federation") (FFF). In 1921, the USFSA finally merged with the FFF.

fanoutqa_038408.x:
Arabian Desert :: People :: chunk_0004
The area is home to several different cultures, languages, and peoples, with [Islam](/wiki/Islam "Islam") as the predominant faith. The major ethnic group in the region is the [Arabs](/wiki/Arab "Arab"), whose primary language is [Arabic](/wiki/Arabic_language "Arabic language").

In the center of the desert lies [Riyadh](/wiki/Riyadh "Riyadh"), the capital of Saudi Arabia, with more than 7 million inhabitants.[[11]](#cite_note-11) Other large cities, such as [Dubai](/wiki/Dubai "Dubai"), [Abu Dhabi](/wiki/Abu_Dhabi "Abu Dhabi"), or [Kuwait City](/wiki/Kuwait_City "Kuwait City"), lie on the coast of the [Persian Gulf](/wiki/Persian_Gulf "Persian Gulf").

Natural resources available in the Arabian Desert include [oil](/wiki/Oil "Oil"), [natural gas](/wiki/Natural_gas "Natural gas"), [phosphates](/wiki/Phosphate "Phosphate"), and [sulfur](/wiki/Sulfur "Sulfur").

Threats to the ecoregion include overgrazing by livestock and feral camels and goats, wildlife [poaching](/wiki/Poaching "Poaching"), and damage to vegetation by off-road driving.[[2]](#cite_note-wwf-2)

The conservation status of the desert is critical/endangered. In the UAE, the [sand gazelle](/wiki/Sand_gazelle "Sand gazelle") and [Arabian oryx](/wiki/Arabian_oryx "Arabian oryx") are threatened, and [honey badgers](/wiki/Honey_badger "Honey badger"), [jackals](/wiki/Jackal "Jackal"), and [striped hyaenas](/wiki/Striped_hyaena "Striped hyaena") already extirpated.[[2]](#cite_note-wwf-2)

She grew up in the [Pittsburgh](/wiki/Pittsburgh "Pittsburgh") suburb of [Edgewood](/wiki/Edgewood,_Allegheny_County,_Pennsylvania "Edgewood, Allegheny County, Pennsylvania"), and the Pittsburgh neighborhoods of [Shadyside](/wiki/Shadyside_(Pittsburgh) "Shadyside (Pittsburgh)") and [Squirrel Hill](/wiki/Squirrel_Hill_(Pittsburgh) "Squirrel Hill (Pittsburgh)"), graduating from the city's [Taylor Allderdice High School](/wiki/Taylor_Allderdice_High_School "Taylor Allderdice High School") in 1974.[[6]](#cite_note-6) As a high schooler, she hitchhiked to Washington, D.C., to protest the [Vietnam War](/wiki/Vietnam_War "Vietnam War")[[7]](#cite_note-7) and lived on her own, working as a cocktail waitress at a local jazz club and a cab driver.[[8]](#cite_note-:7-8)

The same independence that drove Arnold to move out of her childhood home as a teenager also led to a large volume of absences from school and low grades. In spite of this, she made near perfect scores on standardized tests and was determined to attend Princeton University, the alma mater of her father. Map of the Monterey Bay Area, depicting roads, urban areas, major rivers, and forested and grassy areas

**Monterey Bay** is a bay of the [Pacific Ocean](/wiki/Pacific_Ocean "Pacific Ocean") located on the coast of the [U.S. state](/wiki/U.S._state "U.S. state") of [California](/wiki/California "California"), south of the [San Francisco Bay Area](/wiki/San_Francisco_Bay_Area "San Francisco Bay Area"). [San Francisco](/wiki/San_Francisco "San Francisco") itself is farther north along the coast, by about 75 miles (120 km), accessible via [CA 1](/wiki/California_State_Route_1 "California State Route 1") and [US 101](/wiki/U.S._Route_101_in_California "U.S. Route 101 in California").

[Santa Cruz](/wiki/Santa_Cruz,_California "Santa Cruz, California") is located at the north end of the bay, and [Monterey](/wiki/Monterey,_California "Monterey, California") is on the [Monterey Peninsula](/wiki/Monterey_Peninsula "Monterey Peninsula") at the south end. The "**Monterey Bay Area**" is a regional term used to describe the Monterey Bay-adjacent [Central Coast](/wiki/Central_Coast_(California) "Central Coast (California)") communities of [Santa Cruz](/wiki/Santa_Cruz_County,_California "Santa Cruz County, California"), [Monterey](/wiki/Monterey_County,_California "Monterey County, California"), and [San Benito](/wiki/San_Benito_County,_California "San Benito County, California") counties. The three counties, along with Monterey Bay-adjacent cities, collaborate in the Association of Monterey Bay Governments (AMBAG) on regional issues and come together for events like the State of the Region hosted by the Monterey Bay Economic Partnership.

China [borders fourteen countries by land](/wiki/Borders_of_China "Borders of China")[[j]](#cite_note-21) across an area of 9.6 million square kilometers (3,700,000 sq mi), making it the [third-largest country by area](/wiki/List_of_countries_and_dependencies_by_area "List of countries and dependencies by area").[[k]](#cite_note-23) The country is divided into 33 [province-level divisions](/wiki/Province-level_divisions_of_China "Province-level divisions of China"): 22 [provinces](/wiki/Provinces_of_China "Provinces of China"),[[l]](#cite_note-24) 5 [autonomous regions](/wiki/Autonomous_regions_of_China "Autonomous regions of China"), 4 [municipalities](/wiki/Direct-administered_municipalities_of_China "Direct-administered municipalities of China"), and 2 semi-autonomous [special administrative regions](/wiki/Special_administrative_regions "Special administrative regions"). During the season-opening 59–10 loss to the [Baltimore Ravens](/wiki/2019_Baltimore_Ravens_season "2019 Baltimore Ravens season"), Fitzpatrick threw for 185 yards, a touchdown, and an interception.[[135]](#cite_note-135) In the next game against the [New England Patriots](/wiki/2019_New_England_Patriots_season "2019 New England Patriots season"), he threw for 89 yards and was intercepted thrice, with two being pick-sixes, before being benched for Rosen in the 43–0 shutout loss.[[136]](#cite_note-136) After the game, Dolphins' head coach [Brian Flores](/wiki/Brian_Flores "Brian Flores") said that Fitzpatrick would still be the starter in Week 3 against the [Dallas Cowboys](/wiki/2019_Dallas_Cowboys_season "2019 Dallas Cowboys season"),[[137]](#cite_note-137) but on September 19, prior to the game, Rosen was named the starter, sending Fitzpatrick to the bench.[[138]](#cite_note-138)

During a narrow Week 6 17–16 loss to the [Washington Redskins](/wiki/2019_Washington_Redskins_season "2019 Washington Redskins season"), Fitzpatrick relieved Rosen after the latter was benched for poor performance.
